newsitem.title: USA: Allou Health stake upped by Kenneth Dart.
newsitem.headline: Allou Health stake upped by Kenneth Dart.

text.p: Kenneth Dart, President of Dart Container Corp, said Wednesday he raised his stake in Allou Health and Beauty Care Inc to 412,600 Class A common shares or 9.06 percent from 7.98 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dart said his latest transactions include the purchase of 49,500 common shares between February 27 and March 6 at prices ranging from $6.375 to $6.50 per share.
Dart Container Corp is a Mason, Mich.-based maker of polystyrene cups, plastic cultery and dinnerware.
The latest purchases were made through Ross Financial Corp, one of Dart Financial's affiliates. Dart holds the stake as a long-term passive investment.
Allou, based Brentwood, NJ., is engaged in the distribution of health aid products, fragrances and cosmetics.
